name: Ukraine
summary: Ukraine is under martial law. Residents are taxed on worldwide income: investment profit (gains on securities) at 18% PIT plus a 5% military levy (23%); Ukrainian dividends at 5% + 5%; foreign dividends at 9% + 5%. One real-estate sale per year held over three years is exempt. There is no wealth tax. Inheritances and gifts from close family (spouse, children, parents, siblings, grandparents, grandchildren) are taxed at 0% with no military levy when the family member is a Ukrainian tax resident. The war, martial-law restrictions and security risk dominate any relocation decision.

regimes.name: Ordinary tax residence
regimes.description: Ordinary residence; worldwide income taxed at 18% PIT plus the 5% martial-law military levy.
regimes.eligibility: Resident under the permanent home / centre of vital interests / 183-day / citizenship cascade. Foreigners need a residence permit.

capital_gains.summary: Investment profit (gains on securities and corporate rights) is passive income taxed at 18% PIT plus the 5% military levy, 23% in total. Real estate: the first sale in a calendar year of property held more than three years is exempt; further sales in the year are taxed at 5% PIT plus 5% military levy (10%) for residents.

sources.title: Ukraine – Individual – Taxes on personal income

open_questions: The PwC pages do not set out a separate capital gains section for securities; the 18% rate relies on 'investment profit' being passive income at 18%.
Treatment of a sale of foreign real estate not confirmed.
capital_gains.important_exceptions: Military levy (військовий збір) raised from 1.5% to 5% from 1 December 2024 (Law 4015-IX) while martial law lasts; it returns to 1.5% from 1 January of the year after martial law ends.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Securities and private business: 18% + 5% military levy = 23%. Local real estate: 0% for the first qualifying sale each year, 10% (5% + 5%) for further sales; 10% used as the top-end rate. Foreign real estate left null (treatment as foreign-source income at 18% + 5% not confirmed).
capital_gains.holding_period_rules: Real estate: exempt if first sale in the year and held >3 years (not required for inherited property). No holding-period relief for securities found.
capital_gains.foreign_assets: Residents taxed on worldwide income with treaty relief.

dividends.summary: Dividends from Ukrainian CIT-paying companies: 5% PIT + 5% military levy (10%). Dividends from non-residents, mutual funds and non-CIT payers: 9% + 5% (14%). 'Not ordinary' dividends: 18% + 5%.

sources.title: Ukraine – Individual – Taxes on personal income

open_questions: Whether foreign WHT can be credited against the military levy as well as PIT was not verified.
dividends.important_exceptions: Military levy (військовий збір) raised from 1.5% to 5% from 1 December 2024 (Law 4015-IX) while martial law lasts; it returns to 1.5% from 1 January of the year after martial law ends.
dividends.rate_basis: Domestic 5% + 5% = 10%; foreign 9% + 5% = 14% (PwC, reviewed 30 Jun 2026). Headline = 23% for non-ordinary dividends.
dividends.withholding_outbound: 15% WHT on dividends to non-resident companies (treaty 0/5/10%); 5% (or 18%) to non-resident individuals plus military levy.
dividends.treaty_network: About 71 treaties listed by PwC, including the United States and most EU states.

wealth_tax.summary: Ukraine has no net wealth tax. Real estate tax is charged per square metre above exempt areas, plus UAH 25,000 a year for large residences.
wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Real estate tax set locally, capped at 1.5% of the minimum wage per m2 (max UAH 129.71/m2 in 2026) above 60 m2 (flat) or 120 m2 (house); plus UAH 25,000 a year per apartment over 300 m2 or house over 500 m2.

inheritance.summary: No separate inheritance or gift tax; inheritances and gifts are PIT income. From resident family members of the first and second degree (spouse, children, parents, siblings, grandparents, grandchildren) the rate is 0% and no military levy is due (dtkt.ua, May 2026). From other resident persons: 5% PIT + 5% military levy. From or to a non-resident: 18% PIT (plus military levy).

sources.title: Оподаткування подарунка та спадщини у 2026 році: правила для не родичів (22.05.2026)

open_questions: Exact state duty / notarial costs on inheritance of real estate were not quantified.
Whether a non-resident parent leaving assets to a resident child triggers 18% (PwC wording: 'from or by a non-resident') was not confirmed against the Tax Code.
inheritance.eligibility_conditions: 0% only if both the family member and the recipient are Ukrainian tax residents; a non-resident testator/donor or heir triggers 18%.
inheritance.important_exceptions: Military levy (військовий збір) raised from 1.5% to 5% from 1 December 2024 (Law 4015-IX) while martial law lasts; it returns to 1.5% from 1 January of the year after martial law ends. Law 4113 (4 Dec 2024) applies the 5% levy to taxable inherited/gifted property.
inheritance.gift_tax: Gifts follow the same rules as inheritances (0% from close family who are Ukrainian tax residents).
inheritance.domicile_rules: Residence of testator and heir decides between 0% and 18%.
inheritance.spouse_note: 0% personal income tax (and no military levy) when a spouse inherits from a Ukrainian tax-resident decedent (family member of the first or second degree, Tax Code Art. 174); an inheritance from a non-resident decedent is taxed at 18% regardless of relationship, and stamp duty applies to transfers of Ukrainian real estate and vehicles.

residency.tax_residency_test: Cascade: permanent home in Ukraine; if homes in two countries, centre of vital interests; otherwise 183+ days in the calendar year; finally Ukrainian citizenship.

routes.name: Residence permit
routes.requirements: Ukraine is not in the EU; foreigners need a temporary or permanent residence permit. Martial law affects entry and exit. Not researched.

corporate.summary: CIT 18%; financial institutions (except insurers) 25% from 2025; banks a temporary 50%. 15% WHT on dividends to non-resident companies.

sources.title: Ukraine – Corporate – Taxes on corporate income

us_citizen_notes: US–Ukraine income tax treaty exists (listed by PwC); saving clause means US tax still applies.
open_questions: Martial law and the ongoing war make long-term relocation impractical for most families; the tool should flag this beyond tax.
The 5% military levy reverts to 1.5% only after martial law ends.
Cost of living: Pechersk School International's fees (psi.kiev.ua was unreachable) not checked; health insurance, housekeeper and price per m2 not sourced.

prime_rent_monthly.description: Median asking rent of 224 distinct long-term listings (interquartile range USD 2,200-4,500) of flats with 4+ rooms and at least 120 m2 in Kyiv's Pechersk district (Lipky, Pechersk, Chorna Hora, Zvirynets, Saperne Pole) on DOM.RIA, snapshot 2026-10-15: DOM.RIA reported 688 matching 4+ room rentals in Pechersk; duplicates (DOM.RIA's duplicate links, then same rooms, area and price) left 241, of which 224 are 120 m2+. Prices are as DOM.RIA converts them to USD (most listings are quoted in USD; NBU rate on 15 Oct 2026: USD 1 = UAH 44.98); the median is about UAH 144,000. Asking rents; Ukrainian room counts include the living room. Martial law: listings and rents reflect the wartime market. Checked 2026-10-15 against the upper-middle-class standard.

source.title: DOM.RIA - Оренда квартир у Києві, Печерський район, 4+ кімнати (search API)

intl_school_annual_fee.description: Kyiv International School (QSI), 2026-27 annual tuition for the '5 Year-Old Class & Above' band, which covers all grades to Grade 12 (no separate secondary rate): USD 19,600 in three instalments (7,800 + 5,900 + 5,900). Plus a Capital Fund fee of USD 1,600 a year and a one-off USD 600 application fee. Used because Pechersk School International's website (psi.kiev.ua) returned 504 errors on 2026-10-15, so its fees could not be read from the school's own page.

cost_of_living.notes: Rent from DOM.RIA listings in Pechersk (2026-10-15); school fee from Kyiv International School's 2026-27 fee page (Pechersk School International's site was down). Health insurance, housekeeper and price per m2 not sourced. Wartime market under martial law.
